name: Crème Fraîche
siboNotes: Contains moderate lactose levels; start with small portions and monitor tolerance. Those with severe lactose intolerance should avoid or use lactase enzymes.
preparationTips: Use as a finishing touch rather than cooking ingredient to limit serving size
Let come to room temperature for better spreading and flavor
Mix with herbs for a flavorful low-FODMAP sauce base
Store properly refrigerated and use within expiration date
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in calcium for bone health
